name: Decision result
description: What a body decided. Agenda items and votes share this list, so both kinds of outcome use the same terms. No result recorded means it hasn't been decided yet, which is different from deciding to take no action.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Adopted
hasDefinedTerm.description: Agreed as proposed. For an agenda item.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Rejected
hasDefinedTerm.description: Not agreed. For an agenda item.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Amended
hasDefinedTerm.description: Agreed, but in a changed form. For an agenda item.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Deferred
hasDefinedTerm.description: Put off to a later meeting. For an agenda item.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Referred
hasDefinedTerm.description: Sent to another body to consider. For an agenda item.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Withdrawn
hasDefinedTerm.description: Pulled before a decision was made. For an agenda item or a vote.

hasDefinedTerm.name: No action
hasDefinedTerm.description: Considered, then deliberately left alone. For an agenda item.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Received
hasDefinedTerm.description: Noted, with no decision needed — for example, a report. For an agenda item.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Passed
hasDefinedTerm.description: The motion carried. For a vote.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Failed
hasDefinedTerm.description: The motion did not carry. For a vote.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Tied
hasDefinedTerm.description: Equal votes on each side. What happens next depends on the body's tie-breaking rule. For a vote.
